brief.summary: Golden-hour glam — soft, confident, lit from the window

poseRules.tip: Bring their hand up to graze the jaw
Future vocabulary still decodes as a plain string

directions.line: Soft smile, eyes just past the lens
Chin down a touch, then eyes up
Turn their face toward the window light
